name: Nature Day Camp
description_short: Outdoor nature day camp run by the Harpswell Heritage Land Trust, using its preserves as the classroom. Two age groups, 6 to 8 and 9 to 12, spend weekly themed sessions exploring tide pools, salt marshes, shores and forests through games, crafts and hands on science.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Nature Day Camp 2026. Ages 6 to 8: 9 am to 2 pm, $275 a week, optional aftercare 2 to 3 pm for $75 a week. Ages 9 to 12: 9 am to 3 pm, $300 a week. Land trust members get $15 off; prices shown are the non member rates. Drop off at Harpswell Community School (weeks 1, 3, 5, 6) or Bowdoin's Schiller Coastal Studies Center (weeks 2 and 4). Lottery with priority for year round Harpswell residents, then open registration. Scholarships case by case. ZIP is the land trust office at 153 Harpswell Neck Road.

source.title: Nature Day Camp - Harpswell Heritage Land Trust

warnings: Drop off site changes by week, so no single street address is given; the ZIP is the land trust office's.
Registration starts with a lottery that favors year round Harpswell residents.
